messages.content: I want to buy apples, rice, and 12 pack of bottled water from a Walmart near San Jose. Show me the product information and stock availability.

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

The function signature expects pack_size optional array same length as product_list. We can set pack_size [null,null,12] but better to provide [0,0,12] or maybe [1,1,12]? The default is not use it if not specified. So we can pass pack_size [12] only? But the array length should equal product_list. So we need to provide pack_size array of same length. Let's set pack_size [0,0,12]. That indicates no pack size for apples and rice. Or we could omit pack_size entirely. But the function signature says pack_size optional. So we can just not include pack_size. But the user specifically wants 12 pack of bottled water. So we need to indicate pack_size for bottled water. So we can set pack_size [0,0,12]. Let's do that.
